chapter: Biddle, Durham and early road shows
title: The nickname Jazz Baby and the few records he heard
summary: Schoolmates called him Jazz Baby although he had not studied arranging; he heard few records because there was no record player.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Well, by this time had you started arranging, or started studying composition in any way?
No, I hadn't started studying arranging or composition, I was just playing the horn. But I was jazzing, because the boys called me -- nicknamethey called me Jazz Baby.
What do you mean, you were --
The kids around school, you know.
Then you'd heard -- besides the Sweetman Wilbur Spelman records, you'd heard some other records by this time? Let'ssee, what year are we talking about? '17?
We're talking in -- we're in the 1914, '15, '16, '17, like that, and I didn't get a chance to hear too many records, because unfortunately we didn't have a record player.
I heard a few musicians, yes.
